title: Lightly Grilled Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb kebabs served with a soured cream and chive dip, perfect for a low-sodium meal prep option. The dish is characterized by its grassy and shattering flavors.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, chives, soured cream, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt-free seasoning blend.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the yogurt mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs with the remaining yogurt sauce and a side of dum, a traditional Saudi Arabian flatbread.
